title: Toward Auditable and Calibrated AI for Dementia-Related Crash Severity Prediction: A Selective Deferral Framework to Support Human Review
abstract: arXiv:2609.22694v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Public crash databases increasingly support automated safety analysis, but crash severity prediction remains difficult to translate into public-sector decision workflows when models are evaluated primarily as ordinary classifiers. This study reframes dementia-related crash severity modeling as a decision-aware triage problem in which a system must classify crashes into no-injury/property-damage-only (O), minor or moderate injury (BC), and fatal or severe injury (KA), while also controlling outcome leakage, reporting severe under-triage, calibrating confidence, and preserving every raw prediction for audit. Using 4,781 Texas crash records with structured fields and police narratives, we evaluate structured, narrative, fusion, calibrated fusion, BERT-family, and local large-language-model baselines under a stratified 70/15/15 split. translated_title: 迈向可审计且经校准的AI用于痴呆相关事故严重程度预测：一种支持人工审查的选择性延迟决策框架
translated_abstract: 公共事故数据库日益支持自动化安全分析，但当模型主要作为普通分类器进行评估时，事故严重程度预测仍难以转化为公共部门的决策工作流程。本研究将痴呆相关事故严重程度建模重新定义为一个决策感知的分诊问题，即系统必须将事故分类为无伤害/仅有财产损失（O）、轻伤或中度伤害（BC）、以及死亡或重伤（KA），同时控制结果泄漏、报告严重漏判情况、校准置信度，并保留每一条原始预测以供审计。研究使用4,781条包含结构化字段和警方叙述文本的德克萨斯州事故记录，在分层70/15/15划分下评估了结构化模型、叙述文本模型、融合模型、校准融合模型、BERT系列模型以及本地大语言模型基线。在所报告的数据划分中，控制泄漏的Gemma模型获得了最高的观察宏F1值（0.545；95%自助法…）
tldr: 该研究将痴呆相关事故严重程度预测重构为决策感知的分诊问题，提出一个融合置信度校准、泄漏控制、严重漏判报告与可审计性的选择性延迟框架以支持人工审查，其中控制泄漏的Gemma模型取得最高宏F1（0.545）。
en_tdlr: This study reframes dementia-related crash severity prediction as a decision-aware triage problem, proposing a selective deferral framework that integrates confidence calibration, leakage control, severe under-triage reporting, and auditability to support human review, with leakage-controlled Gemma achieving the highest macro-F1 of 0.545.
